### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory containing airrflow pipeline output (multiqc/, clonal_analysis/, repertoire_comparison/, parsed_logs/) |
| `SAMPLESHEET_FILE` | — | Path to the validated samplesheet. Defaults to {DATA_ROOT}/pipeline_info/samplesheet.valid.tsv, which every airrflow run writes. |
| `SKIP_CLONAL_ANALYSIS` | — | Set when the run used --skip_clonal_analysis (params.json skip_clonal_analysis). Prunes every clonal_analysis/ derived DC. |
| `SKIP_REPORT` | — | Set when the run used --skip_report (params.json skip_report). Prunes the repertoire_comparison/ derived DCs. |
| `SKIP_THRESHOLD_REPORT` | — | Set when the run used --skip_report_threshold, or an explicit --clonal_threshold instead of 'auto'. Prunes the threshold summary DC. |
| `SKIP_MULTIQC` | — | Set when the run used --skip_multiqc (params.json skip_multiqc). Prunes the MultiQC DC and the Quality control tab. |
| `ASSEMBLED_MODE` | — | Set when the run used --mode assembled (params.json mode). Prunes the pRESTO log DCs: assembled input skips read pre-processing entirely. |

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`enchantr/clonal_diversity.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/enchantr/clonal_diversity.py) | Hill diversity profiles per sample, from the enchantR repertoire analysis report. | `sample_id`, `subject_id`, `q`, `d`, `d_sd`, `d_lower`, `d_upper`, `e`, `e_lower`, `e_upper` |
| [`enchantr/clonal_overlap.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/enchantr/clonal_overlap.py) | Sample by sample matrix of shared clones, for a clustered heatmap. | `sample_id`, `subject_id` |
| [`enchantr/clone_sets.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/enchantr/clone_sets.py) | Clone by sample presence matrix (0/1) for an UpSet plot of shared clones. | `clone`, `subject_id`, `n_samples`, `total_sequences` |
| [`enchantr/clone_sizes.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/enchantr/clone_sizes.py) | Clone sizes with a within-sample rank and a clonal-homeostasis size class. | `sample_id`, `subject_id`, `clone_id`, `seq_count`, `seq_freq`, `rank`, `size_class` |
| [`enchantr/repertoire_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/enchantr/repertoire_summary.py) | One row per sample: clone counts, clone sizes and the three Hill numbers. | `sample_id`, `subject_id`, `sequences`, `number_of_clones`, `sequences_per_clone`, `clone_size_count_min`, `clone_size_count_median`, `clone_size_count_max`, `richness`, `richness_lower`, `richness_upper`, `shannon`, `shannon_lower`, `shannon_upper`, `simpson`, `simpson_lower`, `simpson_upper`, `evenness`, `evenness_lower`, `evenness_upper` |
| [`enchantr/sequence_counts.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/enchantr/sequence_counts.py) | Sequences left after every pRESTO and Change-O step, one wide row per sample. | `sample_id`, `subject_id`, `sequences`, `retention` |
| [`enchantr/sequence_fates.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/enchantr/sequence_fates.py) | Read fates through the airrflow pre-processing funnel, shaped for a Sankey. | `sample_id`, `subject_id`, `input`, `quality`, `paired`, `consensus`, `assembled`, `representative`, `reads` |
| [`enchantr/threshold_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/enchantr/threshold_summary.py) | Clonal distance threshold per subject, from enchantR's find-threshold report. | `subject_id`, `model`, `cutoff`, `loglk`, `threshold`, `sensitivity`, `specificity`, `pvalue`, `mean_threshold` |
| [`enchantr/v_gene_matrix.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/enchantr/v_gene_matrix.py) | Sample by V gene usage matrix (sequence fractions) for a clustered heatmap. | `row_id`, `sample_id`, `subject_id`, `locus` |
| [`enchantr/v_gene_usage.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/enchantr/v_gene_usage.py) | V gene usage per sample, at family and gene resolution, in long format. | `sample_id`, `subject_id`, `locus`, `rank`, `taxon`, `v_family`, `seq_count`, `locus_count`, `seq_freq` |
